squad_v2.why: THE task shape. Answer is a verbatim span from the passage, or the question is unanswerable and the model must abstain. That is exactly the judge's contract: copy the quote character-exact, or return null. ~130k train / 12k dev, and half the dev set is deliberately unanswerable, so it measures the refusal half too.

ragtruth.why: Grounded generations (RAG responses over given passages). NOTE: this HF copy carries NO hallucination annotations at all — only a quality flag. It is a corpus, not an eval. Kept for the passage/response pairs.

halueval_qa.why: Paired right/hallucinated answers over the same knowledge. Useful as a discrimination eval: can a small model tell the grounded answer from the plausible-but-unsupported one?

fever.why: Claim + evidence-sentence verification (SUPPORTS / REFUTES / NOT ENOUGH INFO). The NEI class is the one that matters here: it is the training signal for 'the evidence does not settle this', which is what our judge does when it returns null.

ragtruth_labeled.why: RAGTruth test split WITH a per-response hallucination label (score: 1=faithful, 0=hallucinated; 740/160 on qa). Response-level, not word-level — the original span annotations live in the ParticleMedia/RAGTruth GitHub repo, not on the Hub. This is the usable faithfulness eval of the three RAGTruth copies checked.

note: public HF datasets; no token used
